meta_description:
5,132 likes, 61 comments - priyamsaraswat on October 17, 2026: "Never imagined my content journey would take me all the way to New York City and into the home of the incredible Chef Vikas Khanna @vikaskhannagroup 🥹❤️

Got to spend a beautiful day with him, explore his NYC apartment and experience the warmth and humility of one of the most inspiring people I’ve ever met.

Some moments remind you why you started this journey in the first place. This was definitely one of them! ❤️

Still have to pinch myself that Chef Vikas Khanna made aloo parathas for me at his home! 😍🥹

I promised you all that this year, we’d take our journey beyond India and explore some of the most incredible homes across the world! 🌎❤️

And here we are, in New York City! 🗽

Got to visit some absolutely stunning homes, meet the wonderful people behind them and discover stories that I can’t wait to share with you all.

This is just the beginning. Stay tuned! 🥹❤️

Some houses were just out of the world 😲😲

There’s something about New York that makes you feel so alive! ❤️

The energy, the people, the endless possibilities… this city inspires you to dream a little bigger and live a little fuller.

And walking across the iconic Brooklyn Bridge? One of those moments I wish I could relive again and again! 🥹❤️

Got lucky to get experience the fall colors 🍁🍁😍😍 And pretented to be a student for a day at Princeton University 😉

Nothing beats walking in this city! You can just walk 20000 steps without even realising. I’ll miss the city walks the most 😢😢

And amidst such insane buildings we have the most beautiful park on this planet - Centrallll Parkkkkkkkkk 🥰🥰

Museums in NYC are out of the world. They have taken creativity to next level! Highly recommend the newly opened Arte Museum to everyone visiting New York City ✌️

New York has spoiled me with its pizza. You can visit any random small or big pizzeria and you will just crave for more. Even their margherita pizza has this amazing flavour and texture 😋😋😋

Did my first ever street interview with the super awssome @khann_journey 

The city looks so pretty in daylight! Huge ass skyscrapers on one side and lush greenery on the other. Best combination! 

But, but, but! It’s breathtaking at night!".
